nameJa: 赤い再生と黒いチャット
conceptNote: 大きな赤い再生記号と右側のチャットを、ひとつの全画面フレームで囲む。
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create ONE standalone sophisticated text-free Chrome extension store listing graphic, landscape aspect ratio 11:7, ideally 1760 x 1120 pixels.
Communicate visually, instantly: watching a video in FULLSCREEN while live chat remains OVERLAID INSIDE the fullscreen video.
Flat Swiss editorial graphic design, very precise generous spacing, warm off-white background. A single very large off-white video rectangle outlined in charcoal, inset from the overall artboard by 10%. Four distinct charcoal L-shaped FULLSCREEN corner brackets are located at the FOUR OUTERMOST CORNERS of that SAME video rectangle. The right-hand corner brackets must sit at the far right outer edge, BEYOND the chat pane: the whole chat is INSIDE their boundary. One continuous video field extends underneath the chat.
Inside the video, large vivid red circular play symbol on the left-center (simple white triangle inside red circle); otherwise EMPTY flat off-white video field. Inside the right quarter of the fullscreen video is an elegant narrow rounded charcoal live chat OVERLAY, with a little gap from the video outer edges. Chat overlay occupies about 27% video width, 72% video height. In the overlay: four simple avatar circles, corresponding pairs of short horizontal message strokes, and a bottom composer drawn as a thin rounded outline with a tiny paper-plane send icon. Absolutely NO text or letters, the messages are ONLY horizontal geometric strokes. Deliberate hierarchy, carefully aligned minimalist UI symbolism, sufficiently large recognizable chat forms for tiny listing thumbnails.
Matte flat colors, sharp edges, no photography, no 3D, no gradients, no glow, no shadows, no landscape scenery, no physical monitor, no window chrome. No caption, title, product name, labels, numbers, letters, fake glyphs or watermark anywhere. Entire design is a diagram with NO typography. Keep broad quiet margins and coherent balanced proportions.

revisions.reason: 初回の横長比率を11:7へ調整し、上下に余白を設ける。
revisions.prompt: Edit this diagram into a 1760 × 1120 pixel image, 11:7 aspect ratio. The OUTPUT IMAGE must be much TALLER than the source, with a near-square landscape shape 1.57:1 instead of panoramic. Recompose all shapes to suit a 440 × 280 store listing tile. Use a large central video frame with a 16:9 interior, and more space ABOVE AND BELOW on the off-white artboard. Make chat height lower to fit its inset inside video. Retain one clear red play disk and the dark chat overlay on right with four avatar circles and geometric line-message strokes. Retain four dark fullscreen corner brackets outside the frame enclosing BOTH video and chat. No words, no letters, no numbers. Do NOT crop any elements, no stretching. Flat editorial diagram, off-white background, no shadows, no gradient. Important: return a landscape image 1760 pixels wide and 1120 pixels high.
